notes: Stored edit, no worlds (mathematics has none). The author of the Elements is reached through written_by, which is functional: after the edit the author is Archimedes, and the facts the record stores about Archimedes (and not about Euclid) carry over. The related question asks whether the Euclidean algorithm is named after the author of the Elements: named_after and written_by are functional, so after the edit the namesake (Euclid) cannot be the author (Archimedes). The Eureka and screw-pump facts are classes (EurekaShouter, ScrewPumpDesigner) because RELATIONS.md has no relation for them.
